speaker: Doctor
text: Given the classic triad of disinhibition, apathy, and hyperorality with weight gain, despite normal metabolic and infectious workups, I am highly suspicious of behavioral variant Frontotemporal Dementia, which may not show significant atrophy on a standard MRI early on.
